{{Quote|If we're lucky it'll be someone like Disk Moosea in that Octofoil. He'll be satisfied with just throwing us a scare.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="TPE" />}}
'''Disk Moosea''' was a member of the [[Torgaigne]] crime syndicate. Moosea was acquainted with [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], who regarded Moosea as relatively non-threatening.<ref name="TPE" />
